description:
Headquartered in Ghent Belgium, BricsCAD (part of the technology giant Octave) is a global provider of design and collaboration software.

BricsCAD® delivers 2D Drafting, 3D Modelling, Sheet Metal, 2D/3D Mechanical, Survey and BIM capabilities out of the box. Those are hugely expanded by our 400+ partners that are developing on top of BricsCAD, empowered by a complete set of APIs.

      For the last two decades, our focus has been building cost-effective, mission-critical design tools. By taking design workflows to the next level and integrating BIM, Mechanical and Surveying design capability, we are the number one CAD alternative.

      At BricsCAD, personalities and cultures connect across oceans to create something extraordinary. Our employees create the engagement and impact that drives our success as we expand globally.

Required skills:

  • Engineering/Architect diploma
  • Autodesk AutoCAD knowledge (other CAD software knowledge is a plus)
  • Ability to speak and write clearly and accurately in English language
  • Good computer/Windows knowledge
  • Availability for learning new technologies
  • Analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • QA experience represents an advantage

Job description:

  • Internal QA testing of a CAD application
  • Gather information and determine the issue by evaluating and analyzing the symptoms
  • Diagnose and resolve technical software issues
  • Research required information using available resources
  • Identify and escalate priority issues per client specifications
  • Offer alternative solutions where appropriate with the objective of retaining customers’ and clients’ business
  • Investigate issues and report to the development team
  • Stay current with system information, changes and updates
  • Provide technical documentation for the Help Center

We offer:

  • Training on site
  • Motivational salary
  • Young and dynamic environment
  • Opportunity to develop CAD/technical support/testing skills and knowledge
  • Flexible work hours
  • Health subscription (Regina Maria)
